categories.main_business_segments: Pinming Technology focuses on digital construction technologies and products for the construction phase, offering application technologies, products, and solutions from construction preparation to completion. Its main business segments include Building Information Modeling (BIM) software and smart construction site products, serving construction enterprises with digital transformation solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as BIM algorithm engines, tower crane safety assistance technology, and a digital construction technology middle platform (APaaS). It develops proprietary BIM 3D graphic platforms and integrates AI, IoT, cloud computing, and big data to enhance construction safety, quality, and efficiency. Production involves software development and hardware assembly primarily at its Xi'an Fengshu subsidiary.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are construction enterprises, especially large state-owned and central enterprises in the building, infrastructure, and energy sectors. The company serves project-level and enterprise-level clients, focusing on public building projects, infrastructure (roads, railways), and new energy construction projects such as nuclear and thermal power plants.
categories.geographic_coverage: Pinming Technology operates primarily in China, with a strong presence in Zhejiang province and expanding markets in other provinces including East China, Central China, South China, North China, Southwest, and Northwest regions. The company is expanding its sales network nationwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction industry supply chain by providing digital construction software and integrated smart construction site hardware solutions directly to construction enterprises and project sites.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening digital transformation in construction, enhancing BIM and AIoT technologies, and expanding enterprise-level digital construction platforms. R&D focuses on BIM 3D graphic platform upgrades, AI applications in construction safety and progress monitoring, IoT innovations for equipment safety, and low-code platforms for rapid application development. The company invests heavily in R&D with over 500 technical staff and numerous patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of proprietary software and smart construction hardware products, supplemented by customized development services, after-sales support, training, and subscription-based enterprise-level platform services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales with some dealer distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Pinming Technology is among the earliest and leading domestic providers in the construction information technology sector, particularly in BIM and smart construction site solutions. It holds competitive advantages in comprehensive BIM toolchains, proprietary tower crane safety technologies, and integrated digital construction platforms, positioning it strongly against peers in a market with relatively low digital penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 435.7 million, with a slight year-over-year increase. It achieved a net profit of RMB 12.4 million, reversing previous losses. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 911 million and continues to invest significantly in R&D, accounting for over 28% of revenue. Cash flow from operations improved substantially due to better order quality and receivables management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Pinming Technology emphasizes its deep industry expertise, comprehensive BIM and digital construction solutions, and proprietary core technologies such as tower crane safety systems and digital construction middle platforms. Its products integrate advanced IT technologies tailored to construction industry needs, enabling clients to improve cost control, safety, quality, and project management efficiency, thereby facilitating the digital and intelligent transformation of construction enterprises.
